headline: Ned Luke, the actor behind Michael in GTA 5, has pushed back on claims that GTA 6 looks too similar to its predecessor.
body: Ned Luke, the actor behind Michael in GTA 5, has pushed back on claims that GTA 6 looks too similar to its predecessor. Reacting to fans making the comparison, Luke said: “ This looks nothing like Grand Theft Auto 5. I’ll tell you one thing: I never looked that good.” He also said fans making that comparison are “out of their minds.”
